messages:
will: Heads-up: Atlasly wants a short performance validation before we finalize commercial terms. Ask: sustain 1k req/s steady, handle 3k bursts for ~5m, avg output ~240 tokens. p95 target <= 450ms. They want a hosted baseline + Dedicated price comparison and any security blockers up-front. Call Thurs AM.
anya: Quick clarifying Qs: single-turn or chat? typical prompt size? do they need multi-region failover for the POC?
will: Single-turn. Prompt avg ~200 tokens. No multi-region for POC, single region is fine. Hosted preferred but they explicitly want Dedicated numbers.
morgan: I can run the bench tomorrow. Proposed plan (compact):
- Warm 8m -> 300 rps
- Steps: 300 -> 600 -> 1k -> 1.8k -> 3k (4-5m per step)
- Sustain 20m at 1k, short 5m spike at 3k
- Collect p50/p95/p99, error rates, GPU util, ingress queue metrics
Variants: models = [13B-q4, 34B-q4, 70B-8bit], batch_size = [8,12], kv_cache = [on,off]
Add headers: X-Req-Id, X-Prompt-Tokens, X-Resp-Tokens for correlation.
ops-bot: perf-job queued, cluster=perf-bench-east, workers=48, est start=60s
morgan: Quick smoke CLI + k6 snippet for the deck:
```bash
# curl smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"13B-q4","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":240,"batch_size":8}'

# k6 pseudo
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'13B-q4', input:'...', max_tokens:240}), { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${__ENV.KEY}` } });
}
```
ops-bot: run started, start_ts=7901234500, job_id=perf-7901
morgan: Initial smoke (13B-q4, batch=12, kv_cache off): p50=160ms, p95=720ms, p99=1020ms, errors=1.8% (timeouts around 1.8k->3k step). Observed ingress queueing and worker-side batching spikes.
leo: Try batch=8 and 34B-q4, and instrument worker queue lengths. Also check KV cache hit rate for their sample corpus.
morgan: Re-ran (13B-q4, batch=8): p50=210ms, p95=460ms, p99=760ms, errors=0.3%. Sustained 20m at 1k stable. Spike to 3k produced transient 503s during the 1.8k->3k ramp but recovered.
morgan: 34B-q4 batch=8: p50=195ms, p95=420ms, p99=690ms, errors=0.4%. Memory pressure increased on hosts so fewer concurrent shards per host. KV cache hit rate for Atlasly sample ~7% (very high variance) so caching won't materially help baseline.
anya: Good. Sales needs a short cost sketch + recommendation for deck. Can you draft numbers?
morgan: Preliminary cost sketch (very rough):
- Hosted: steady 1k rps, avg 240 tokens -> estimated ~$31k/mo (compute + network + infra margin). Bursts add hourly infra but ballpark.
- Dedicated: reserved fleet (approx 6-8 A100-equivalent GPUs) amortized infra ~$22k/mo, Redwood platform & support -> customer quote ~$28k/mo with SLA 99.9% and typically lower tail latency (p95 ~400-430ms).
- Recommendation: Offer Hosted trial for fast onboarding, show Dedicated quote as preferred for predictable monthly cost + SLA.
sec: Security asks from Atlasly: CMEK/customer-managed KMS, SOC2, data retention policy, VPC peering for Dedicated. We support AWS/GCP KMS (CMEK) and provide SOC2 PDF. For Hosted we can provide private endpoints & IP allowlist; Dedicated supports VPC peering. We'll need a short key-rotation test window for CMEK. SOC2 link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2.pdf
sales-bot: Sales checklist for the call: 1) one-slide perf summary (p50/p95/p99 + brief run notes) 2) Hosted vs Dedicated cost ranges 3) Security checklist & next steps (CMEK & SOC2) 4) link to raw artifacts. Deadlines: perf slide by Wed noon, quote by Wed EOD, sec docs sent by Wed EOD.
morgan: Uploaded artifacts to perf/7901234567/ (grafana snapshots, logs, run-metadata). End_ts=7901234620. I'll attach links in the invite.
will: Great work. Action owners: Morgan perf slide + artifacts, Anya finalize deck and lead Thurs call, Sec to send KMS checklist + SOC2 by Wed EOD, Leo prepare Dedicated sizing notes for quote. I'll schedule Thurs 10am demo. :thumbsup:
